_rule: The author's decision of 22 October 2026 (rule B). A record leaves the PRIMARY sample (outcome 'mature_cohort') when (a) its development table is not retranslated between the year t-1 and year t reports across a sterling/dollar move of 5% or more, so that the step from the t-1 diagonal to the t diagonal carries the translation of the foreign-currency part of the book, AND (b) the filing's own gross claims-outstanding roll-forward prints an exchange line of at least 5% of the opening gross claims outstanding R (absolute value). A record for which either condition fails stays. The loader (run_analysis.py) removes an 'excluded' entry's record from the primary at the unusable-severity step with the tag FX_UNTRANSLATED_TABLE and counts it (fx_untranslated_excluded); under outcome 'precedence_672' the register is not read and nothing changes. An entry is applied only with two independent readings of the filing (F1, F2) that give the same opening gross claims outstanding and the same exchange line, a table not retranslated, a line of at least 5% of R, and the pages and quotes. 'read_and_kept' entries record the candidates both readers found to fail a condition; the loader validates them and applies nothing for them. A kept entry states its reason: no_fx_line_printed, fx_line_under_5pct, table_retranslated (a line of 5% or more of R, and the table retranslated), or undeterminable_kept (a line of 5% or more of R and no year t-1 table to test condition (a): rule B excludes a record only when both conditions are shown, so it stays). Built by src/build_fx_untranslated_excluded.py from the archived readings.
